scope: Selected authored resource generators; no extracted art, native binaries, generated samples, tests, logs, or rollback materials.
normalization: Only listed local absolute path literals become explicit environment options. All source and public SHA256 values are listed separately; imports, conversion algorithms and resource values are preserved.
external_inputs: Original game asset exports for each weapon, Unity JSON/meshes/ANM/GLB and source textures/audio as referenced in the scripts.
Original companion workspace layout and matching baseline mod/gunpack where referenced.
Python plus relevant numpy/scipy/Pillow/UnityPy dependencies; original named Minecraft/TaCZ/mapping tools for scripts that invoke Java tooling.
